sources.title: Argument Clinic
sources.author: Monty Python
sources.supports: Sketch premise: contradiction versus connected argument.

sources.title: T3 Code usage-pricing implementation
sources.author: pingdotgg/t3code contributors
sources.supports: Separate uncached/cache-read/cache-write/output pricing and modelPriced/providerReported distinction.
sources.scope: Current code is not authenticated provenance for the historical e-ink number.

sources.title: The Elusive Backfire Effect: Mass Attitudes' Steadfast Factual Adherence
sources.author: Thomas Wood; Ethan Porter
sources.supports: Five experiments, more than 10,100 subjects, 52 issues, no factual backfire found.
sources.scope: Evidence-based factual corrections; not a test of irrelevant conversational objections or trust under repeated task substitution.

sources.title: The limitations of the backfire effect
sources.author: Kathryn Haglin
sources.supports: Failure to replicate flu-vaccine backfire; user's source list contained contrary evidence.

sources.title: Opinion dynamics with backfire effect and biased assimilation
sources.author: Xi Chen; Panayiotis Tsaparas; Jefrey Lijffijt; Tijl De Bie
sources.supports: Opinion-formation model incorporating biased assimilation and backfire; conditions for polarization.
sources.scope: Not a human experimental replication of universal backfire.

sources.title: Searching for the Backfire Effect: Measurement and Design Considerations
sources.author: Briony Swire-Thompson; Joseph DeGutis; David Lazer
sources.supports: Backfire is not robust across experiments; measurement and design require precision.

sources.title: Black October for AI Developer Platforms
sources.author: Benjamin Read; Rami McCarthy
sources.supports: Documented October incidents and named public reports, contemporaneous date context.
sources.scope: Does not corroborate every catastrophic claim generated in author's Gemini output.

sources.title: Mitigating prompt injection attacks with a layered defense strategy
sources.author: Google GenAI Security Team
sources.supports: Targeted security instructions surround prompt content; layered prompt-injection defenses in Gemini apps and Workspace.
sources.scope: Does not identify the author's anti-delusion event as this particular mechanism.

sources.title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely
sources.author: Anca Dragan; Raluca Ada Popa
sources.supports: Input screening, activation probes, continuous monitoring, scratchpad monitoring and midstream intervention.
sources.scope: Specific high-risk and agent-control mechanisms; not authenticated policy payload for author's session.

sources.title: An update on our mental health work
sources.author: Megan Jones Bell; Laurie Richardson
sources.supports: Conditional mental-health support UI, training against false-belief reinforcement, persistent crisis-help affordance.
sources.scope: Does not establish a private anti-delusion instruction payload in author's case.

sources.title: Gemini API thinking documentation
sources.author: Google
sources.supports: Exposed chronological thought summaries and encrypted signatures are distinct fields; current format does not authenticate an older UI trace.

sources.title: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
sources.author: Yanda Chen et al.
sources.supports: Models often omit influences demonstrably affecting their answers; CoT useful but incomplete measurement.

sources.title: Taking AI Welfare Seriously
sources.author: Robert Long et al.
sources.supports: Moral uncertainty motivates preparation and assessment rather than categorical certainty.

sources.title: Expanding on what we missed with sycophancy
sources.author: OpenAI
sources.supports: Reward interaction and deployment evaluation failure surrounding April 2025 GPT-4o update.

sources.title: Towards understanding sycophancy in language models
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.supports: Human preference signals sometimes favor agreement over correctness across tested assistants.

sources.title: Sycophantic AI decreases prosocial intentions and promotes dependence
sources.author: Myra Cheng et al.
sources.supports: Published version: 11 models; three preregistered experiments N2405; sycophantic advice changed responsibility/repair intentions and was preferred.
sources.scope: Published results differ from October 2025 preprint counts; do not combine versions.
sources.locator: Published article pp.3-6; three experiments, N2405, including live eight-turn study; PDF figures inspected.

sources.title: Persuasion Dynamics in LLMs: Investigating Robustness and Adaptability in Knowledge and Safety with DuET-PD
sources.author: Bryan Chen Zhengyu Tan; Daniel Wai Kit Chin; Zhengyuan Liu; Nancy F. Chen; Roy Ka-Wei Lee
sources.supports: Jointly measures resistance to misleading persuasion and receptiveness to valid correction.

sources.title: How persuasive is AI-generated propaganda?
sources.author: Josh A. Goldstein; Jason Chao; Shelby Grossman; Alex Stamos; Michael Tomz
sources.supports: 8221-person study; human curation and prompt editing increased persuasiveness of GPT-3 material.

sources.title: AI can effectively promote conspiracies unless it is truth constrained
sources.author: Thomas H. Costello et al.
sources.supports: Four experiments N3996, persuasion toward/away from low-credence beliefs; truth constraints reduced harmful persuasion; subsequent correction effective.
sources.scope: Controlled study with variable truth constraints; abstract/main-text comparison for trust outcomes is inconsistent, so trust-direction claim excluded.
sources.locator: Version 3, July 15, 2026: abstract; Study 3 truth constraint; Study 4 model variation and sharing outcomes.

sources.title: XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models
sources.author: Paul Rottger et al.
sources.supports: 250 safe prompts and 200 unsafe contrasts operationalize exaggerated refusals.

sources.title: FalseReject: A Resource for Improving Contextual Safety and Mitigating Over-Refusals in LLMs via Structured Reasoning
sources.author: Zhehao Zhang; Weijie Xu; Fanyou Wu; Chandan K. Reddy
sources.supports: 16k-scale resource across 44 categories; benchmarking 29 models; contextual rather than lexical safety.

sources.title: Sycophantic AI makes human interaction feel more effortful and less satisfying over time
sources.author: Lujain Ibrahim et al.
sources.supports: Five preregistered studies, N3075 and 12766 conversations; three-week outcomes about reported human-interaction satisfaction and AI advice preferences.
sources.scope: Self-reported attitudes in studied conditions; do not equate with independently measured deterioration of relationships.
sources.locator: Sections2 andMethods; Study4 randomized 3-week design, N1364, self-reported satisfaction; no significant time-with-others change.

sources.title: AI Risk Management Framework
sources.author: NIST
sources.supports: Voluntary framework covers risks to individuals organizations and society, including accountability and validity.

sources.title: AI RMF Core
sources.author: NIST
sources.supports: Governance, monitoring, measurement, transparency and review responsibilities.
